title: Discount Program Rate Courtesy on Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Interest
content:
*Rate sheet note — discount programs.*

For a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion, the discount program on the contract the account finances adjusts the annual rate of its monthly interest: the military or first-responder program takes the service rate courtesy of 0.50% off; the senior program takes the senior rate courtesy of 0.25% off; no program leaves it.

The program is the single discount program recorded at signing on the financed contract — the Window Replacement Contracts contract or the Entry & Patio Door Contracts contract the account funds. The courtesy is taken off the purchase APR in arriving at the annual rate, and the annual rate never falls below zero.

| Discount program on the financed contract | Annual rate courtesy |
|---|---|
| Military | Less 0.50% |
| First responder | Less 0.50% |
| Senior | Less 0.25% |
| None | No change |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A purchase APR of 8.00% on a contract carrying the first-responder program, with nothing else changing the rate: 7.50%.
- The same purchase APR on a contract carrying the senior program: 7.75%.
- A purchase APR of 0.25% on a contract carrying the military program: 0.25% less 0.50% is below zero, so the annual rate is 0.00%.
